parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Calculate the number $N$ of molecules in the gas.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text:
The mass of one molecule of the gas is $40\text{ u}$.

Determine the root-mean-square (r.m.s.) speed of the gas molecules.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The temperature of the gas is increased by $84^\circ\text{C}$.

Calculate the value of the ratio

$$\frac{\text{new r.m.s. speed of molecules}}{\text{original r.m.s. speed of molecules}}.$$

stem: A fixed mass of an ideal gas is at a temperature of $21^\circ\text{C}$. The pressure of the gas is $2.3 \times 10^5 \text{Pa}$ and its volume is $3.5 \times 10^{-3} \text{m}^3$.
